subject.title: feat(ui): finish the chat session → thread rename across the Control UI

question: Should the Control UI consistently call these conversational records “threads” in the remaining user-facing worktree, usage, external-catalog, and lifecycle-copy contexts while native clients continue to use “session” for now?
rationale: The merged predecessor establishes the general direction, but this PR intentionally includes several identified borderline terms whose product meaning cannot be resolved from code or tests alone.

options.title: Approve the Control UI sweep
options.body: Accept the proposed Control UI wording boundary and keep native-client terminology for its coordinated follow-up.

options.title: Narrow the borderline strings
options.body: Retain the clear chat-page rename but restore selected worktree, external-catalog, or lifecycle-state labels to “session.”

options.title: Pause for cross-client terminology
options.body: Defer this sweep until Web, iOS, Android, and macOS wording can be decided together.

recommendation.title: Approve the Control UI sweep
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed Control UI wording boundary and keep native-client terminology for its coordinated follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history supplied for the merged predecessor and this follow-on sweep makes steipete the clearest available owner for the terminology boundary.
